description: This file defines the 'Create' feature for articles in a web application, including data models, validation logic, command handling, and database interactions for creating a new article.

classes.name: Create.ArticleData
classes.description: Data transfer object for article input, including title, description, body, and tag list.

classes.name: Create.ArticleDataValidator
classes.description: Validator ensuring ArticleData fields are not null or empty.

classes.name: Create.Command
classes.description: Request command encapsulating article data for creating a new article.

classes.name: Create.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validator for the Command, ensuring the contained ArticleData is valid.

classes.name: Create.Handler
classes.description: Handles the creation of a new article, managing database interactions and related entities.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Asynchronously processes the create article command by inserting data into the database and returning the new article envelope.
